en.headline: Election Committee voting underway as Tang inspects polling stations
en.dek: Polls opened at 9am on Sunday for 856 candidates contesting 723 seats; Security Secretary Chris Tang visited two stations this morning.
body: Voting in the 2026 Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections began at 9am on Sunday, with eligible voters casting ballots at five ordinary polling stations across Hong Kong.

Security Secretary Chris Tang inspected the stations at Kowloon Park Sports Centre and Harbour Road Sports Centre this morning and spoke with staff on site, according to reports from RTHK and other outlets.

A total of 856 candidates are contesting 723 seats in 31 subsectors, with about 5,700 people eligible to vote. Voting continues until 6pm, after which ballot boxes will be taken to the central counting station at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre in Wan Chai.
Two dedicated polling stations are also open at Happy Valley Police Station and Shek Pik Prison. Voters must present their original Hong Kong identity cards at the station listed on their poll card.

zh.headline: 選委會選舉投票進行中 鄧炳強巡視票站
zh.dek: 周日上午九時開始投票，856名候選人競逐723席；保安局局長鄧炳強今早到訪兩個票站視察。
body: 2026年選舉委員會界別分組一般選舉周日上午九時開始投票，合資格投票人可到全港五個一般投票站投票。
保安局局長鄧炳強今早先後到九龍公園體育館及港灣道體育館票站視察，並與現場工作人員交談，據港台及其他報道指。
今屆31個需要競逐的界別分組有856名候選人競逐723個席位，合資格投票人約有5700人。投票至下午六時結束，其後所有票箱會運往灣仔香港會議展覽中心的中央點票站點票。
另外兩個專用投票站設於跑馬地警署及石壁監獄。投票人須帶備香港身份證正本，到投票通知卡列明的票站投票。
